svg.text: ROUGH PROTOTYPE · AWAITING ASTRA PASS · YOK-159
Merchant shop · states (labels are annotation, not UI)
The item rolls up in place: tied, sealed, grey borrowed ink,
tag reads SOLD, not selectable again. Others do not shift.
Dimmed, Enter does nothing, coin chip shakes, nothing changes.
All four slots are full. Replace which?
Esc cancels, nothing changes. Foxfire row warns: Tanuki target.
A little polish on your move.
event: bought_modifier (the target step itself has no line yet)
Slippery Skin: pick the special that carries it
Same step as the reward screen's modifier card. Esc backs out.
Letting one go? Kind of you,
event: release_binding (confirm step has no line yet)
It loses its levels; the slot frees up.
Default focus on Keep. After: 'It is gone. Do not look back.'
Enter does nothing; no Release chip on this slot (T5).
A tied cord and a seal, not a grey button.
All gone! You've cleaned me out.
All yokai bound or everything bought. Footer keeps only Back.
Same cabinet one tier shorter, so items, tags, bubble, slip and
slots panel are all unchanged; the cabinet is just 1 shelf lower.
Designer's note: 6 may suit balance better than 9. The main
sheet draws 9; the choice is open (R6 shop size).
Example stock again; picked from unbound yokai, specials first.
bubble: lead-in would make 3 sentences, so card text alone
same format as the reward screen and move list
Tab / Y toggles; stays on while focus moves
The merchant never speaks these numbers (A12).
Pulls opponent one step closer on hit
Heals 2% of max health on hit
Open: data/moves has no Kappa specials yet, so the
special numbers above are placeholders; a modifier
shows 'Startup +N' only if its data carries one
The slip covers the portrait's body only; the head and bubble
tail stay visible, so the merchant still reads as the speaker.
